finalPrompt: Create one original unofficial fan-made full-body static game plate of Dachande, the licensed Dark Horse and NECA Broken Tusk Predator. Use a strict three-quarter side profile facing right on a pure opaque #00FF00 background. Show him unmasked so one visibly damaged outer tusk identifies him, with otherwise coherent Yautja mandibles, ochre mottled skin, ringed black dreadlocks, worn aged-bronze classic AVP armor, netted undersuit, compact shoulder caster and retracted wrist blades. Secure a long heavy Yautja blade across his back in a visible harness and a compact sidearm in a holster; hold no weapon so both hands are fully visible. Keep the entire character, dreadlocks, back blade, hands and feet inside the portrait frame with padding. No floor, shadow, scenery, text, logo, UI, watermark, collage, biomask, two broken tusks, missing jaw, extra limbs, malformed hands, floating weapons, Cracked Tusk, Ahab, Samurai sword, Alpha armor, checkerboard or fake transparency.
